Happy Diwali
from Dhruv

Dhruv wishes you a happy and prosperous Diwali.

Layer 1: The darkness

Every Diwali begins in the dark.

A quiet night. One small flame is all it takes to change the whole sky.

Layer 2: The sparkler rangoli

Draw your rangoli with a sparkler.

Drag your finger on the board. Your sparkler paints a mirrored rangoli.

Layer 3: The crackers

Light up the sky!

Tap anywhere to send a rocket there, or choose a cracker below.

Layer 4: The diyas

Light all nine wishes.

Tap each diya to light it and reveal what it holds.

Layer 5: The five days

Diwali is five days of light.

Many people remember Lord Ram coming home to Ayodhya, welcomed by a path of lit diyas. Tap each day.

Layer 6: Lakshmi’s coins

Catch the golden coins.

Coins 0   Time 15s

Tap Start, then tap as many falling coins as you can in 15 seconds.

Layer 7: The sky lantern

Send a wish into the sky.

Type a wish for someone you love. It will rise as a glowing lantern.

Layer 8: The wish
शुभ दीपावली

Happy Diwali to all

from Dhruv

Dhruv wishes you a happy and prosperous Diwali.

May your home fill with light, your heart with joy, and your year with sweetness.
